proposal.label: needs reproducible example
proposal.comment: Could you share a small, shareable input (for example a CSV or SQL VALUES block) that still triggers this error when run with the shown SQL, together with the complete error text/stack trace produced by DuckDB? The sanitized query is helpful, but reproducing the internal binder/planner failure requires an example input or table schema/data that triggers the problem.
proposal.rationale: The report includes a sanitized SQL shape and environment details but lacks any concrete shareable input or minimal table data/schema; without sample data or an equivalent VALUES-based repro the internal planner error cannot be reliably reproduced.
